dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 10, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Mets and Rangers Soar to Victory in Thrilling Fashion**

The New York Mets edged out the Atlanta Braves 8-5, behind a dominant performance from Christian Scott on the mound. Brett Baty went 1-for-3 with a home run and four RBIs to pace the Mets' offense. Meanwhile, MacKenzie Gore threw 5.1 scoreless innings with nine strikeouts to propel the Texas Rangers to a 4-1 win over the Los Angeles Angels. Mike Trout went 1-for-2 with a home run for the Angels, but it wasn't enough to overcome Gore's impressive outing.

In other games, the Philadelphia Phillies held off the St. Louis Cardinals 6-5, thanks in part to a strong start from Hunter Dobbins. Edmundo Sosa went 2-for-3 with three RBIs to lead the Phillies' offense. The Houston Astros also came out on top, defeating the San Francisco Giants 6-3 behind a solid start from Blade Tidwell. Cam Smith went 3-for-4 with a home run and two RBIs for the Astros.
